Abdhi
dh. by Kedāra (?) Q. by Śrīdharasvāmin in Smṛtyarthasāra.

a.
Kane, HDS. I. p. 336. suggests that it may mean the Smṛtimahārṇava.
See also
, where a. Anuṣṭubh verse seems to mention Kedāra a. its a.; this seems to be a verse taken from Śrīdhara's Smṛtyarthasāra. See

Abdhinauyānamīmāṃsā
by Kāśiśeṣa Veṅkaṭācala Śāstrin.
Pt.. Veṅk. Press, Bombay, 1903.

Abdhimathana
a. Apabhraṁśa sandhibandha kāvya, by Caturmukha. ref. to in Śṛṅgāraprakāśa by Bhoja. ch. XI; see V. Raghavan, Bhoja's Sr. Pra., 1963, p.. 405, 628, 772, 823, 835; q. by Vāgbhaṭa in his Alaṅkāra tilaka. C. on his own Kāvyānuśāsana. K. M. edn. p. 15. IO. I. p. 332a.
